core.title: Stop Bumper for LCN 4111T Closer, LCN-4110T-169-N
tags: LCN-4110T-169-N Door Closer Stop for LCN 4111T Series Concealed Door Closers

text.description_html:
LCN 4110T Series Door Closer Stop/Bumper

This is the New Style door stop for LCN 4111T Track Closer (LCN Super Smoothee) Surface Mount Track Arm Closer.

Also available other LCN Door Closer Parts

These stop cushions mount into the door closer track and are held in place with the (2) included set screws.
Must have LCN 4110T-3038 new style track.

*Sold Individually
